name: AddEvent
desc: Create and manage calendars, events, and RSVPs with AddEvent — the add-to-calendar service.

actions.name: create_event
actions.description: Creates a new event on your AddEvent calendar.

actions.name: update_event
actions.description: Updates an event on your AddEvent calendar. Only the fields you fill in are changed.

actions.name: delete_event
actions.description: Deletes an event on your AddEvent calendar.

actions.name: find_event
actions.description: Finds events matching a search term. Returns up to 20 of the best matches.

actions.name: find_or_create_event
actions.description: Searches for an event by a term. If no match is found, creates a new event with the details below.

actions.name: create_rsvp_attendee
actions.description: Creates a new RSVP attendee on your AddEvent event.

actions.name: delete_calendar_subscriber
actions.description: Deletes a subscriber from your AddEvent calendar.

actions.name: create_add_to_calendar_links
actions.displayName: Create Dynamic Add to Calendar Links
actions.description: Creates an AddEvent event and returns its shareable "Add to Calendar" links. Opening a link lets recipients add the event to Apple, Google, Outlook, and other calendars. Each run produces a unique link, so links can be personalized per recipient.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_calendar_subscriber
triggers.description: Triggers when a new subscriber is added to your AddEvent calendar. Leave the calendar blank to watch all of them.

triggers.name: new_rsvp_attendee
triggers.description: Triggers when a new attendee RSVPs to your AddEvent event.
